name: Wildspitze
kurzbeschreibung: Bergrestaurant Wildspitze at 2,840 m at the top station of the Gletscherexpress in the Pitztal – Tyrolean specialities with a view of the glacier world.
beschreibung: The Bergrestaurant Wildspitze is located at 2,840 metres at the top station of the Gletscherexpress on the Pitztaler Gletscher in the municipality of St. Leonhard im Pitztal. On the upper floor of the top station, above the self-service restaurant Kristall, guests can enjoy traditional Tyrolean cuisine as well as international specialities. The offering is complemented by cakes and tarts from the in-house patisserie – the highest in Austria. The large sun terrace offers a wide view of the glacier world and the Chapel of the White Light; from it you can access the glacier area directly. The restaurant is open daily from 09:00 to 16:00 during the operating hours of the glacier cable car and is also suitable for groups and training teams. It is operated by Pitztaler Gletscherbahn GmbH & Co KG.
